title: Implement TPS snapshotting harness with p95 drift alerting
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a robust tokens-per-second (TPS) snapshotting harness that captures steady-state throughput and p95 latency across core models and input distributions, stores historical snapshots, and runs automated drift detection to alert on regressions. This ticket covers the harness, CI integration, dashboards, and basic triage playbook for investigators.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run against configured core models and produce per-model snapshots (tps, p50, p95, sample_count) for defined workloads
Snapshots are persisted to S3 with a stable schema and retention policy (90 days) and are queryable by date and model_variant
Automated regression detector runs daily and raises an alert when sustained p95 increases exceed configured thresholds (absolute and relative)
Nightly CI job executes the harness for smoke inputs and fails only on deterministic regressions (flaky run mitigation applied)
Grafana dashboard exists showing historical TPS and p95 for core models with annotated deploys and detected regressions
implementation_notes: Sampling windows: run 30-minute steady-state phases per model with variable concurrency profiles (low/medium/high) to capture realistic KV cache behaviour
Sequence length mix: include 8k, 2k, 512 token distributions with pinned prompts to avoid tokenization variance
Warmup: run a 3-minute warmup to populate KV caches; exclude warmup tokens from TPS/p95 calculation
Metrics: emit token_count, request_count, total_generation_time_ms, p50_ms, p95_ms, sample_count; ensure tags for model, revision, region, runtime-config
Persistence: use S3 path `s3://redwood-benchmarks/tps-snapshots/<date>/<model>-<revision>.jsonl` and register schema in Glue for ad-hoc queries

Regression detection: primary heuristic is sustained p95 delta > 15% for 3 consecutive daily snapshots OR absolute p95 increase > 200ms with sample_count >= 1000; secondary check runs Mann-Whitney U to validate distribution shift
CI: nightly job in GitHub Actions (self-hosted runners) that pulls pinned model revisions; job annotates PRs when a regression is detected within 24h of merge
Cost control: limit concurrent runs and budget with sampled subset of models for nightly, while full-suite runs weekly
Data retention and privacy: snapshots contain no user prompt text — only synthetic prompts and metadata
Observability: expose run_id and per-request traces to X-Ray for postmortem; record seed and workload descriptor for reproducibility
test_plan: Unit tests for snapshot serializer and schema validation
Integration test that runs harness on a tiny local model and asserts expected metrics schema
Synthetic regression injection test: intentionally add 20% delay in runtime path and assert detector flags regression
Flakiness test: run harness 5x under same config and verify median p95 variance < 7% for stable models
E2E CI run: nightly job must complete within configured budget and write snapshots to S3
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): run harness against 3 core models in staging for 2 weeks; validate schema and dashboards
Phase 2 (extend): add remaining core models, enable regression detector in alerting-only mode for 7 days
Phase 3 (enforced): enable CI gating annotations and automated issue creation when high-confidence regressions occur
Phase 4 (optimize): add adaptive sampling & cost throttles based on observed run times
